changes.title: Education Guides Page (/guides.html)
changes.description: Launched a comprehensive long-form guide that replaces the previous nav placeholder. Explains Archon's MCP-native architecture, the five-persona governed lifecycle (Analyst → Architect → Tech Lead → Orchestrator → Developer), the conversation-to-code workflow, and the principle of Strict Similitude between UML diagrams and generated code.

changes.title: Interactive Spec → UML → Code Demo
changes.description: Browser-side interactive demo on the Guides page parses a live spec, renders a Mermaid class diagram in real time using the same algorithm as the Architect persona, and previews 60+ enterprise-grade generated files. Auto-tour cycles through hand-picked files (JWT guard, exception filter, migration SQL, Dockerfile, Jenkinsfile, README) with prev / play / next controls plus ← / → / space keyboard shortcuts.

changes.title: MCP-First Quickstart Aligned with docs.html
changes.description: Guides quickstart now matches the canonical install pattern: install the archonspecs bridge globally, then paste the SSE-URL-with-apiKey MCP snippet into any MCP-capable client. Lists every officially-supported client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, OpenClaw, Windsurf, VS Code with Cline / Continue, Zed) and frames the CLI as the back door rather than the front door.

changes.title: Color-Coded Sidebar Navigation
changes.description: Guides sidebar uses five accent colors (orange / blue / purple / green / pink) on section titles and active links so users get peripheral-vision feedback about which 'chapter' of the page they're reading as they scroll.

changes.title: Guides Nav Wired Across All Public Pages
changes.description: Replaced the dead Guides placeholder in docs.html, benchmarks.html, and changelog.html with proper links to guides.html so the new page is reachable from anywhere in the site.

changes.title: Google Search Console Indexing API Integration
changes.description: Configured robot service account ownership across Domain and URL-prefix properties, achieving 10/10 automated indexing success via the GSC submit_batch tool.

changes.title: Technical SEO & Structured Data Hardening
changes.description: Fully overhauled public landing pages with premium meta descriptions, high-intent title tags, and 100% valid JSON-LD schemas (WebPage, TechArticle, SoftwareApplication).

changes.title: Video Indexing & Architecture Migration
changes.description: Replaced dynamic JavaScript modals with static HTML5 iframe embeds and launched dedicated video landing pages for 100% crawler discovery and rich snippet eligibility.

changes.title: Product Rebranding & Content Expansion
changes.description: Completely rewrote archon-mcp.html and archon-os.html to eliminate third-party noise, detailing the official Archon Specs MCP materialization toolchain and introducing the upcoming Archon Desktop App.

changes.title: Pipeline Materialization Stability
changes.description: Resolved a fatal temporal dead zone ReferenceError in the streaming telemetry callback, ensuring successful project materialization.

changes.title: Topological Compilation & Schema Hardening
changes.description: Added dependsOn support to the domain schema and fixed the domain shard tool to preserve graph dependencies during DAG sorting.

changes.title: Auto-Pathing Normalization
changes.description: CLI generator and normalization engine now automatically scaffold HTTP routes from operation names, reducing manual specification burden.

changes.title: Diagram Viewer SVG Matrix Error
changes.description: Resolved an InvalidStateError caused by the SVG pan/zoom library attempting to invert a 0x0 matrix when reopening hidden diagram modals.

changes.title: Diagram Rendering Normalization
changes.description: Fixed Mermaid rendering on Dashboard by correctly stripping markdown metadata and synchronizing diagram type identifiers across the Control Plane.

changes.title: Distributed Control Plane
changes.description: Fundamental shift from template-driven scaffolding to a deterministic architectural control plane with canonical internal state.

changes.title: Capsule Linking Architecture (CLA)
changes.description: Introduced modular orchestration core for horizontal scalability and monorepo-safe incremental evolution.

changes.title: Transactional VFS
changes.description: Implemented a fully transactional Virtual File System with atomic commits, rollback support, and dry-run execution.

changes.title: Semantic AST Mutation
changes.description: Integrated ts-morph for safe, idempotent code mutation, replacing string replacement with semantic import and decorator injection.

changes.title: Drift Detection & Reconciliation
changes.description: Added state-aware orchestration that detects and reconciles structural drift using managed ownership policies.

changes.title: Execution Plan Protocol
changes.description: Replaced ZIP-based transport with distributed execution plans for token-safe, deterministic synchronization.

changes.title: WebSocket Stream Engine
changes.description: Introduced persistent WebSocket connections for high-speed, real-time architectural materialization.

changes.title: Workspace Materializer
changes.description: Enhanced local authority enforcement for workspace-level project generation.

changes.title: Schema Validation Logic
changes.description: Hardened UML-to-IR transformation to prevent data loss in complex relational mappings.

changes.title: CLI Tooling
changes.description: Refined error reporting and diagnostic logging for the global archonspecs CLI.

changes.title: Initial Genesis Release
changes.description: Launch of the Archon Specs MVP, featuring basic UML parsing and NestJS project scaffolding.
